experience.label: Professional Journey
experience.subtitle: From NLP research to generative AI for remote sensing — a progression through applied deep learning and open-source contribution.

citius.org: CiTIUS – Research Center in Intelligent Technologies
citius.desc: As part of my Master's thesis research, I redesigned StyleGAN3 to tackle classification tasks under conditions of severe data scarcity and class imbalance, applied to drone-acquired multispectral imagery. I extended the network discriminator with a fully connected classification head and trained the model end-to-end from scratch on multidimensional datasets. The results are currently being written up as a manuscript for submission to a top-tier peer-reviewed journal.
citius.achievement1: Achieved Average Accuracy within 2.5 percentage points of state-of-the-art Vision Transformer models.

citmaga.org: CITMAGA – Galician Centre for Mathematical Research and Technology
citmaga.desc: Collaborated with the statistical classification research group to design and implement multiclass support for the open-source caretEnsemble R package, extending the existing codebase to integrate the team's novel statistical research. The work involved close collaboration between mathematics and software engineering, translating theoretical models into robust, tested features for the open-source community.

gradiant.org: Gradiant – Galician R&D Center in Advanced Telecommunications
gradiant.desc: Optimized NLP inference pipelines through distributed data parallelism (DDP), significantly boosting system throughput. Also benchmarked and integrated distributed computing frameworks — including Ray and Dask — to improve the scalability of research prototypes.
gradiant.achievement1: Boosted NLP inference performance by 2.5× through DDP parallelization.
gradiant.achievement2: Improved system scalability by integrating Ray and Dask distributed frameworks.

citiusNLP.org: CiTIUS – Research Center in Intelligent Technologies
citiusNLP.desc: A one-month research initiation scholarship within the NLP group, focused on studying neural machine translation architectures for low-resource language scenarios. Trained and evaluated a Galician–Spanish translation model using OpenNMT, achieving a BLEU score of 64.3%.
